cat <<EOF
print("text for cat, whatever it looks like")
EOF

jq '.name' <<'JSON'
{"name": "stdin of jq is data"}
JSON

awk '{ print $1 }' <<EOF
stdin of awk is data
EOF

python3 script.py <<EOF
input for script.py
EOF

python3 -m json.tool <<'JSON'
{"a": 1}
JSON

psql -c 'select 1' <<EOF
psql reads no stdin once -c is given
EOF

bash scripts/x.sh <<EOF
input for x.sh
EOF
